page: Microsoft Azure HB368-48rs_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the HBv5 family. It is equipped with an Intel processor providing 48 dedicated vCPUs under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system includes 448.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 9.33 GB of RAM per core.

This server features a bundled local storage configuration consisting of 15851 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. It is designated as both RDMA capable and Premium Storage capable, supporting high-speed interconnectivity and advanced storage configurations. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory-to-core ratio and the substantial local NVMe SSD storage capacity, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource sharing. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include large-scale databases, memory-intensive analytics, and storage-bound enterprise applications.
